w14-lamps.observed_description: Ana's living room in the evening with the curtains closed: from left to right a floor lamp glowing warm yellow, a TV on a low cabinet showing mountains and a lake, a second identical floor lamp with a dull grey unlit shade, and an open laptop with a black screen on a small desk; no reflections.
w14-lamps.note: Usable: two identical lamps told apart only by on and off, the TV on and the computer off; every target sits inside the frame.

q13-diego-asks.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) stands alone in Ana's bright living room, turns toward the right and asks with both open hands lifted; nobody else and no body part at any edge.
q13-diego-asks.note: Usable as Diego's question view: nobody else can be read as the he of his question.
